tutorials.title: Welcome to Global Merchant
tutorials.text: Welcome to Global Merchant. Browse the local market first, then pick your next flight; follow real airline routes to buy local specialties and earn the spread.

tutorials.title: Buying goods
tutorials.text: The goods are now in your baggage. Open the Flights tab to see all departing flights. Business class offers more baggage room — great for long-haul trading.

tutorials.title: Heading to the gate
tutorials.text: Ticket booked. Use Skip to takeoff to jump ahead to boarding, or let game time pass naturally. Note: perishable goods degrade while you fast-forward.

tutorials.title: Arriving in a new city
tutorials.text: Welcome to a new city. Open the Market tab to see local prices. Buy cheap at the origin, sell dear where it's scarce — that's the key to profit.

tutorials.title: First sale
tutorials.text: First sale complete. Watch supply and price gaps between cities and plan a route that maximises your profit margin as you continue your journey.
